direct_source_specific.scope: Four pinned external compatibility candidates; no Royal names/classes/resources. This is not proof of no generic behavior.

hooks.name: Antidote Vessel antidote
hooks.condition: Server Player receives nonbeneficial effect; equipped usable antidote.
hooks.change: duration=int(duration*(1-stat(antidote,amount))); includes harmful/neutral holders, not custom entity booleans.

hooks.name: Antidote Vessel devourer
hooks.condition: Player AttackEntityEvent against LivingEntity with beneficial effects, strengthScale>.9, equipped usable devourer.
hooks.change: Remove/readd each target beneficial holder with duration reduced by stat*20, attempt transfer to attacker; native effect/remove events remain. Only beneficial bundle/selected potion branches mapped.

hooks.name: Cross Necklace
hooks.change: invulnerableTime+=int(stat*20); unequip subtracts int(modifier). Guardian rapid resets before its next own request; other ordinary admitted hits retain native cooldown handling.

hooks.name: Power Glove
hooks.condition: Damage owner Player, equipped usable power, stored time>=5.
hooks.change: Incoming amount*=1+stat, stored time reset0. Mapped only player-owned Crimson Arrow damage path; not ownerless environmental or boss-owned damage.

hooks.name: Vampiric Glove
hooks.condition: Post-damage owner Player with usable equipped vampire.
hooks.change: Owner heal(min(victimMaxHP,newDamage*stat)); probability in callback is experience, not healing gate.

hooks.name: Umbrella
hooks.condition: Player holding umbrella, using an item, no umbrella cooldown, LivingEntity source owner, normalized source-to-player look dot>=.65.
hooks.change: Cancels incoming; axe owner imposes110 cooldown. After cancellation pushes alive nonself LivingEntities inAABB3 by normalizedAway*(.4+gliderCount*.2), Y/5; Player motion uses network packet. Does not gate Cult hurt-independent movement. Ownerless magic/fire/tip fall do not enter this source-owner branch.

hooks.name: Kitty Slippers
hooks.condition: Player reaches uncanceled death event with usable equipped rescue and native random/chance gate.
hooks.change: NORMAL death rescue HP1/cancel; Cult HIGHEST mask/HIGH Chance run first and normally prevent this lower handler from receiving the event. Competition is ordered, not simultaneous.

hooks.name: Chorus Totem
hooks.condition: Player post-damage from another LivingEntity, usable equipped past, HP>=1, missingHP*chance>=random.
hooks.change: Moves attacker, zeros velocity, tries safe spot in shrinking radius; does not rewrite source damage identity.

hooks.name: Thorn Pendant
hooks.condition: Player post-damage from another LivingEntity, equipped usable poison and chance gate.
hooks.change: Attacker invulnerableTime0; thorns request=newDamage*multiplier then actual POISON duration=time*20 amp1 independently of retaliation hurt result.

hooks.name: Shock Pendant
hooks.condition: Server Player post-damage with nonnull owner and usable equipped lightning/chance gate.
hooks.change: Visual-only lightning entity plus explicit native lightningBolt hurt(stat damage) to owner after invulnerableTime0. Its separate Player lightning-immunity hook has no matching primary Cult lightning producer.
